case_status: Held out from candidate authoring. Frozen before any native actor run. Not used to tune prompts or toolkit changes after outcomes.
dispatch: All actors run sequentially. Repeat order is single, quality, operations, synthesis, feedback, revision, evaluator.
design: Three arms. Strong single with on-demand skills. Two independent workers with literal merge. The same workers with synthesis, delegated AI feedback, and revision.
paired_limit: Merge and synthesis arms share worker outputs. Charge those workers fully to both arms. This is not an independent end-to-end comparison.
budget_limit: No external paid model API, new key, GPU, push, PR, or release. At most 14 native actor/evaluator calls. The lead and outer coordinator are pre-existing native contexts.
feedback_scope: One synthetic inherited wrong claim and one delegated AI feedback step per repeat. No human feedback or scientific approval is claimed.
authority: Parent task relay quotes user authorization: 按照你的规划帮我在云端codex上完成下一阶段的优化，使用6astra ultra fast. The approved four-stage toolkit plan includes this minimal native evaluation.
fast_tier: Unverified. The native tool has no Fast-tier parameter.
budget_fairness: The arms use the same task and model request but different role counts. This study compares complete workflows under a shared study cap, not equal-token budgets.
analysis_commitment: Report all scores and both repeats. Keep negative results. Make no significance, cost, speed, broad superiority, or human-review-cost claim.
